units.source_text: 三月初十过后，明石女御分娩，大小平安。

en.t: After the tenth day of the third month, the Akashi Consort gave birth, and both mother and child were safe.

units.source_text: 在这以前，大家认为一大难关，纷纷愁叹。

en.t: Until then, everyone had thought it would be a great ordeal, and they had all been grieving and worrying.

units.source_text: 岂知临盆并无多大痛苦，而且生下来的又是一位皇子，真是无限欢欣！

en.t: But unexpectedly, the labor brought no great suffering, and the child born was another imperial prince, filling everyone with boundless joy.

units.source_text: 女御现在所居的房室，隐藏在正屋后面，和别人的房室很接近。

en.t: The rooms where the Consort was now staying were tucked behind the main building and lay very close to other people's quarters.

units.source_text: 产后各处纷纷前来祝贺，排场异常盛大，礼品十分隆重，在老尼姑看来这里真是“神仙窟”啊！

en.t: After the birth, people came from every quarter with congratulations; the ceremony was extraordinarily grand and the gifts splendid, so that to the old nun the place seemed truly like a cave of immortals.

units.source_text: 然而这地方毕竟太简陋了，于是准备迁回紫夫人东南院中原来的屋子里。

en.t: Yet the place was, after all, too plain, so preparations were made to move her back to her former rooms in Lady Murasaki's southeastern wing.

units.source_text: 紫夫人亦曾到西北院来看视。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had also come to the northwestern wing to visit her.

units.source_text: 但见女御身穿白衣，抱着婴孩，俨然是个母亲，那模样真是可爱。

en.t: She saw the Consort dressed in white and holding the baby, looking every bit a mother, and the sight was truly lovely.

units.source_text: 紫夫人自己没有生育经验，别人生育她也难得看到。

en.t: Lady Murasaki herself had never given birth, and she had rarely seen others do so either.

units.source_text: 此次看到了，觉得非常稀罕可爱。

en.t: Seeing it now, she found it wonderfully rare and endearing.

units.source_text: 初生的婴儿要好生照管，因此紫夫人一天到晚抱着。

en.t: A newborn baby needed careful tending, and so Lady Murasaki held him in her arms from morning until night.

units.source_text: 真的外婆明石夫人一切都让紫夫人做主，自己专任汤沐之事。

en.t: The child's true grandmother, Lady Akashi, left everything to Lady Murasaki and took charge only of the bathing.

units.source_text: 以前宣布立皇太子的圣旨的宫女典侍，是司理汤沐之事的。

en.t: The court lady Naishi no Suke, who had once announced the imperial decree naming the crown prince, was the one responsible for overseeing the bathing.

units.source_text: 她看见明石夫人自动来帮助她，觉得很对她不起。

en.t: When she saw Lady Akashi come of her own accord to help her, she felt deeply apologetic toward her.

units.source_text: 明石夫人出身的内情，典侍曾经约略闻知。

en.t: Naishi no Suke had already heard something of the circumstances of Lady Akashi's birth and background.

units.source_text: 明石夫人的人品如果略有缺陷，女御不免丧失体面。

en.t: If Lady Akashi's character had shown even the slightest flaw, the Consort could hardly have avoided losing face.

units.source_text: 然而明石夫人气度十分高雅，因此典侍觉得她真是命运特别优异的人。

en.t: Yet Lady Akashi's bearing was exceedingly refined, and so Naishi no Suke felt that she was truly a woman blessed with an exceptional fate.

units.source_text: 此次祝贺之盛况，一如向例，不须赘述。

en.t: The splendor of the celebrations on this occasion followed the usual custom and need not be described at length.
